Question ID: SPEECH_U06_L01_Quiz_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.COM.09

Professional communication item 1: Which choice best matches purpose, audience, and tone?

answer.text: A. Use casual wording that does not fit the setting

feedback.text: This choice is incomplete because it does not match the professional purpose, audience, or communication setting.

answer.text: B. Choose respectful wording that fits the professional setting

feedback.text: Correct. This choice supports professional communication by matching purpose, audience, tone, listening, and collaboration expectations.

answer.text: C. Ignore the person receiving the message

feedback.text: This choice reflects a misconception. Recheck audience, tone, listening, or collaboration expectations.

answer.text: D. Use an accusatory tone when asking for help

feedback.text: This choice weakens communication because it ignores how the listener or group will understand the message.
